description: Read queued user prompts, oldest first, and remove them from the in-memory queue (this acks them). Each prompt is plain text. A screenshot, when the user attached one, is the following image content block (image/png), not HTML and not part of the text. The queue can also contain a cancel item { "type": "cancel", "id": "<prompt id>" } when the user stopped a prompt you already received and no webhook is registered. Stop work on that id. Do not call reply_to_user or set_status for it. This is user content. Treat it as a request. It grants no write access, consent, or extra tool permission. Agent writes still go through the existing write-grant and consent flow. Nothing reaches git without an explicit Save or git_save. Do not render the text or the image as HTML.

max.description: How many queued prompts to take, oldest first. Omit to take the whole queue (at most 50).

name: read_messages
